# lcd.setClipping

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.1.0</span></div>

Set the clipping rect.

```lua
local width = lcd.setClipping(x, y, w, h)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | number | yes | X coordinate |
| `y` | number | yes | Y coordinate |
| `w` | number | yes | rectangle width |
| `h` | number | yes | rectangle height |

## Returns

width (integer): window with

## Examples

```lua
-- draw a striped fill that must not spill past the filled width
lcd.setClipping(barX, barY, fillW, barH)
lcd.drawBitmap(barX, barY, STRIPES)
lcd.setClipping()                          -- reset
-- or: lcd.setClipping(0, 0, lcd.getWindowSize())
```
